Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|A_{01310013}|^p) \leq C_01310013\) follows from the continuous Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via rational interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
